name: First Steps
description: Move your character for the first time. Every journey through San Diego begins with a single step.

name: Conversationalist
description: Complete 3 dialogues with the people of San Diego. Listen well — every voice has a story.

name: Curious Mind
description: Open 5 different panels. A curious traveler learns more than a hasty one.

name: Cartographer
description: Open the Minimap. Knowing the land is the first step to understanding its people.

name: Scholar
description: Open the Rizal Codex. Knowledge of history lights the path forward.

name: Diarist
description: Open your Journal. Recording observations is the mark of a thoughtful traveler.

name: Help Seeker
description: Open the Help panel. Even the wisest scholar sometimes needs guidance.

name: Polyglot
description: Open the Filipino Glossary. Language carries the soul of a people.

name: Gossip Collector
description: Overhear the kitchen staff gossiping at the market. Words travel fast in a small town.

name: Ibarra Witness
description: See Crisóstomo Ibarra crossing the plaza at dawn. A returning son carries the weight of two worlds.

name: Listener
description: Earn the Chapter 1 medal. You have heard the voices of San Diego — and understood.

name: Night Owl → Early Bird
description: Experience the time transition from afternoon to morning. San Diego wears a different face at dawn.

name: Persistent Pilgrim
description: Try to walk into the church walls 5 times. Faith, perhaps, is also persistence.

name: The Wanderer
description: Take 50 steps exploring San Diego. To walk is to know a place.

name: The Old Code
description: Discover the ancient sequence known to scholars of an older era.
